1) Conditions for transport and time to RNA extraction. The sorting process can result in a poor prognosis for genomic material extraction, especially RNA; therefore, the RNAprotect Cell Reagent Qiagen Catalog # 76526 reagent was used. The protocol was standardized as follows: For every 4 mL of volume recovered from the separated cells, 1 mL of RNAprotect Cell Reagent Qiagen Catalog # 76526 was added. This ensured the protection of the RNA.

steps.title: Configure FACSAria II instrument
steps.instruction: Set nozzle size to 80 mm, flow rate to 1.0–2.6 (units as per instrument), and flow threshold to a maximum of 8,000 events per second. Choose laser and filter settings for Pacific Blue and APC‑Cy7 (or the fluorochromes you will use). Perform compensation setup using unstained, single‑stained, and fluorescence‑minus‑one (FMO) controls.

steps.title: Harvest and pelletize cells
steps.instruction: Trypsinize keratinocyte cultures, transfer cells to 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, and centrifuge at 3,000 rpm, room temperature for 5 minutes to form a pellet.

steps.title: Block cells with FACS solution
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell pellet with 1 mL of FACS blocking solution at 4 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend in labeling solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the blocked cells at 3,000 rpm, 4 °C for 3 minutes, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 100 mL of labeling solution.

steps.title: Add antibodies and incubate
steps.instruction: Adjust the cell suspension to exactly 1 × 10⁶ cells per sample, add the standardized antibody concentrations (as per fluorochrome protocol), and incubate at 4 °C while gently agitating every 15 minutes to prevent precipitation.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend for sorting
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL PBS+ to the stained cells, centrifuge at 3,000 rpm, 4 °C for 3 minutes, discard the supernatant, then resuspend directly in 600 µL PBS+. Transfer the suspension into flow‑cytometry tubes.

steps.title: Add viability dye (optional)
steps.instruction: If a viability dye is required, add it to the cell suspension according to the dye’s manufacturer instructions before the final resuspension step.

steps.title: Transport samples on ice
steps.instruction: Move the prepared tubes from the wet‑lab to the sorting unit within 1.5 hours, keeping them on ice with gel antifreeze to maintain cell stability.

steps.title: Set gating and sorting parameters
steps.instruction: Define the gating hierarchy (FSC/SSC → singlets → viable → CD49f/CD71 quadrants). Choose target populations (e.g., CD49f^bright/CD71^dim or CD49f^dim/CD71^bright). Set sorting speed, drop delay, and collection settings accordingly.

steps.title: Sort target populations and assess purity
steps.instruction: Run the sort to collect the defined subpopulations, then perform a post‑sort purity check to confirm sorting accuracy.

steps.title: Stabilize and transport sorted cells for RNA
steps.instruction: After sorting, keep the collected cells at 4 °C in RNAprotect Cell Reagent, transport them on ice, and maintain temperature stabilization of containers before downstream RNA‑Seq processing.
